_comment_cpu: 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB. Nothing like the surfaces jobs: this runs ~20 aggregate SQL queries over the operational tables and writes ~20 rows. No grid, no raster, no basis matrix. The smallest valid Fargate pairing is enough and the task is billed per second.

containerDefinitions.name: surfaces
containerDefinitions._comment_image: The same image as every other job. It already carries backend/ and the interpreter, so a KPI-only image would be a second thing to rebuild and a second place for the library set to drift. SURFACE_BUCKET is not needed here and is deliberately absent.
containerDefinitions._comment_secrets: SSM SecureString rather than plaintext env. The task role needs ssm:GetParameters and kms:Decrypt on the parameter's key.
containerDefinitions._comment_logs: Same group as the other jobs so /admin/jobs and the log console stay in one place. The stream prefix is what distinguishes this job's runs.
